New concepts and predicates are permitted. A chapter's mention of a function does not fully explain it. Distinguish general explanatory knowledge from unknown choices or measurements in the particular case. Reject an assertion of a particular case's unstated choice or measurement as unsupported uncertainty; that restriction does not apply to general definitions, mechanisms or qualified possibilities. Do not recursively expand incidental concepts. There is no quota; honor proposal_limit when non-null. Do not infer an unknown case-specific choice from what is generally possible.
